summary: Tested EduNet Schedule Module (Horarios). All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend schedule page loads and displays data correctly at /school/demosettings/schedule. Logo appears in header, grade dropdown shows 14 grades, teacher dropdown shows 5 teachers.

integration_issues.issue: Route is /school/:subdomain/schedule but user expected /school/:subdomain/horarios. Need to add alias route.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 (existing issue from previous iteration)

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login returns token and user data
GET /api/academic/grades returns 14 grades (3 Inicial, 6 Primaria, 5 Secundaria)
Logo appears in header on schedule page
Grade dropdown shows 14 grades sorted by level
3 tabs present: Horario de Clases, Horario de Profesores, Horario de Exámenes
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add route alias /school/:subdomain/horarios -> SchedulePage for Spanish URL consistency
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schedule module is fully functional. The correct URL is /school/demosettings/schedule (not /horarios). All APIs working: /api/settings returns logo_url, /api/academic/grades returns 14 grades, /api/users returns 5 teachers. Frontend displays all data correctly.

verified_features.teacher_dropdown: Shows 5 teachers (Jorge, Nicolás, Sonia, Pedro, Julia)
